source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 19100 Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington, TX: labour index L=0.885, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.816; 47-2111 0.926; 47-2152 0.959; 47-2061 0.835; 49-9021 0.964. L = 0.885; factor = 0.40*0.885 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.95. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: Denton builds to the 2021 International Residential and Energy Codes, with local and North Texas regional changes, in effect since June 2022. Zoning is set by the Denton Development Code; we could not yet load the setbacks for the common small-lot districts, so you will need to enter your district or plat lines. If your lot is in or within 200 ft of a mapped floodplain, the floor and A/C unit must sit at least 18 inches above the 100-year flood level for a fully built-out watershed. The building permit is about $0.89 per square foot plus a $141 plan review, roughly $2,700 for a 2,400 sq ft home with a garage. Water and wastewater impact fees were raised in 2025 and depend on meter size and plat date; ask the city for the current amount. Plan on an engineer-designed foundation because of clay soils. The city cannot require brick, but your HOA may.
